# Paginate liked albums and liked playlists to get all song_ids
all_album_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_albums(access_token=login_response['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    for album in page:
        all_album_song_ids.update(album['song_ids'])
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

all_playlist_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_playlists(access_token=login_response['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    for pl in page:
        all_playlist_song_ids.update(pl['song_ids'])
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Combine all song_ids from liked songs, liked albums, liked playlists
all_song_ids = set()
for song in all_liked_songs:
    all_song_ids.add(song['song_id'])
all_song_ids.update(all_album_song_ids)
all_song_ids.update(all_playlist_song_ids)

print(f"Total unique song_ids: {len(all_song_ids)}")
print(sorted(all_song_ids))
